metadata.selection_rationale: Selected 3 lenses from request/domain/engagement signals: Market and Competitive, Financial, Operational Capability.

question: Using only public web sources, produce a concise research report on the current state of the U.S. auto body repair industry consolidation trend. Include 5 cited factual claims, source links, and a short note on evidence gaps. Keep the report compact.

selected_lenses.description: External market structure, customer demand, competitors, substitutes, and industry trends.
selected_lenses.label: Market and Competitive

selected_lenses.description: Revenue, costs, margins, cash flow, capital intensity, valuation, and financing risk.
selected_lenses.label: Financial

selected_lenses.description: Capabilities, workflows, execution capacity, process maturity, and delivery constraints.
selected_lenses.label: Operational Capability
